Subject: Supplier onboarding — legal entity details & PO wiring

Hi Elena / Green River Accounts team,

Thanks for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. To get your vendor master set up and enable POs and electronic payments, can you confirm the following fields and return copies of the supporting docs listed below? If you prefer to send some items via DocuSign, that works too — I can generate a link.

Required for vendor master creation:
- Legal name exactly as registered (inc. any d/b/a)
- Entity type (e.g., LLC, Corporation) and state/country of formation
- Federal Tax ID / EIN
- Registered business address (street/city/state/postal)
- Remittance address if different from registered address
- Invoice email address and PO routing email
- Preferred payment method (ACH or Wire) and U.S. bank or international details if outside US

Please attach: a completed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), a Certificate of Incorporation (or equivalent), and a voided check or bank letter for ACH. I am attaching our standard onboarding form to capture the fields (Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf).

Once we receive the docs we typically complete vendor creation within 3–5 business days; finance may follow up if any tax or banking items need verification.

Small ask: If you can return the documents by EOD Wednesday (05/06) that would keep the timeline intact.

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Form.pdf (attachment)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

We'll set up the vendor record as:

- Tax ID: 12-3456789
